_about: Foreign residence. BPHS 23.11 desad desantaram from the twelfth; 11.11 pravasa from the tenth.

activation.STRONGLY_ACTIVE: Matters of residence abroad are strongly activated in the period examined, with indications in the birth chart, the running dasha and current transits.
activation.ACTIVE: Matters of residence abroad are active in the period examined, indicated in the birth chart and activated by the running dasha.
activation.BACKGROUND: The birth chart carries a standing indication about residence abroad that nothing in the current period is activating.
activation.MIXED: Matters of residence abroad are active in the period examined, and the indications point in both directions.
activation.INACTIVE: No indication about residence abroad is admitted under the current methodology profile.
